metadata.description: Claude Code mods from UTUVO: a running-sessions band, session color themes, a setup catalog, chimes, a guard against dangerous commands, quiet tool rows, a to-do band, and a loudness card for audio work. 中英雙語。

plugins.name: utuvo-session-board
plugins.description: a band above the prompt listing the Claude Code sessions busy right now on this Mac and how long each has run; over 3 hours is flagged as possibly stuck. Updates every 5 s.

plugins.name: utuvo-session-colors
plugins.description: the color block at the start of a session title (16 kinds: 🟥🟧🟨🟩🟦🟪🟫⬛⬜🔳🟢🔷🔶🔹🏢🪐) sets a whole desktop theme and a night-sky backdrop; a 🔥 in the title adds a slowly breathing glow. Desktop app, dark mode.

plugins.name: utuvo-catalog
plugins.description: /catalog opens a pane with the tokens each MCP server, skill, memory file and agent adds to the context, how often each was used and when last; anything unused for 14 days is marked. Read-only.

plugins.name: utuvo-chime
plugins.description: one soft chime when a turn of 20 s or longer finishes, a second one when Claude waits for your answer or a permission prompt opens. /chime off | on | test.

plugins.name: utuvo-guard
plugins.description: checks every Bash command before it runs and stops the ones people fear an AI agent doing: rm -rf on your home or Documents, a force push to main, git reset --hard over uncommitted work, committing .env or private keys, DROP TABLE / DELETE without WHERE, erasing a disk. Protects folders you list (photos, thesis, masters) from being deleted, moved, overwritten or converted in place. Add `# guard-ok: <reason>` to override; everything is logged to ~/.local/log/utuvo-guard.log.

plugins.name: utuvo-quiet-tools
plugins.description: hides finished tool rows (Ran, Read, Edited…) in the desktop and mobile apps so the conversation reads like a chat; a running step shows one dim line, and errors stay visible. /quiet-tools off | on.

plugins.name: utuvo-todo-band
plugins.description: a line above the prompt with how many `- [ ]` items are still open in your TODO.md and the first one; a pane lists them all by section. Reads TODO.md in the project folder, else ~/TODO.md, or the file you set. Read-only. /todo-band off | on | list.

plugins.name: utuvo-loudness
plugins.description: when ffmpeg measures loudness (ebur128 or loudnorm), draws Integrated, True Peak and LRA under the tool row and checks them against Atmos Music, Apple Music, Spotify/YouTube and EBU R128 targets.
